network_release: OS Open Roads 2026-04 (one snapshot for every period)

2019.caveat: Retrospective backtest, not a ranking that existed in 2019: the model type, hyperparameters and features were chosen in 2026 on development folds with targets up to 2023. This cutoff's target 2020-2021 was one of the selection targets. COVID-affected years (2020, 2021) fall in this cutoff's history, training or target windows, so totals are less reliable than ranks. Road segments, classes and junctions are the OS Open Roads 2026-04 snapshot (used for every period), not the network of 2017-2019.

Road segments, classes and junctions are the OS Open Roads 2026-04 snapshot (used for every period), not the network of 2018-2020.

Target 2023-2024 overlaps the already-examined 2024-2025 holdout. COVID-affected years (2020, 2021) fall in this cutoff's history, training or target windows, so totals are less reliable than ranks. 2023.caveat: Retrospective backtest, not a ranking that existed in 2023: the model type, hyperparameters and features were chosen in 2026 on development folds with targets up to 2023. Target 2024-2025 is the final holdout, already examined: not an untouched test. COVID-affected years (2020, 2021) fall in this cutoff's history, training or target windows, so totals are less reliable than ranks. Road segments, classes and junctions are the OS Open Roads 2026-04 snapshot (used for every period), not the network of 2021-2023.

2025.caveat: Production forecast: the released v2.0 scores, reproduced by the saved production model (not refitted). 2026-2027 is not yet observed. The model was trained on the 2024-2025 outcomes of the examined holdout. Road segments, classes and junctions are the OS Open Roads 2026-04 snapshot (used for every period), not the network of 2023-2025.

omitted_cutoffs.2024: target 2025-2026 is incomplete: the data end in 2025

ranking_kinds.retrospective_backtest: model ranking refitted at the cutoff (2019-2023)
ranking_kinds.observed: ranking of recorded counts: observed_target_rank, observed_history_rank, and the count baselines in capture.csv

tie_handling: capture: tie block at the cut counted pro rata; overlaps and persistence: expected values under independent random tie-breaking (topk_inclusion); stored observed_*_rank columns order ties by segment_id for convenience only

columns.cutoff: last year of data the ranking may use
columns.ranking_kind: what predicted_* are: 'retrospective_backtest' (2019-2023, refitted at the cutoff) or 'production_forecast' (2025)
columns.train_feature_period: history window of the training pair (features c-4..c-2)
columns.train_target_period: target window of the training pair (c-1..c); never beyond the cutoff
columns.history_period: history window the ranking is computed from (c-2..c)
columns.target_observed: whether the forecast period is complete in the data
columns.segment_id: OS Open Roads 2026-04 segment (same id in every period)
columns.predicted_adj_ksi: MODEL OUTPUT: expected adjusted KSI casualties in forecast_period
columns.predicted_rank: MODEL RANK: 1 = highest predicted_adj_ksi; ties by segment_id ascending (production rule)
columns.observed_target_adj_ksi: RECORDED: adjusted KSI casualties in forecast_period; null when not observed
columns.observed_target_rank: RECORDED RANK (observed): rank of observed_target_adj_ksi; null when not observed. Recorded counts tie heavily, at zero and at positive values (e.g. 1.0 adjusted KSI); tied segments are ordered by segment_id only, which is arbitrary. Do not build top-k sets from this column: the summaries use tie-aware inclusion probabilities (topk_inclusion)
columns.observed_history_adj_ksi: RECORDED: adjusted KSI casualties in history_period
columns.observed_history_ksi_cas: RECORDED: KSI casualties as reported in history_period
columns.observed_history_ksi_collisions: RECORDED: collisions with >= 1 KSI casualty in history_period
columns.observed_history_rank: RECORDED RANK (observed): rank of observed_history_adj_ksi (the count ranking a history-only method would give). Ties at zero and at positive values are ordered by segment_id only; use tie-aware statistics, not top-k sets from this column
columns.network_release: road network used for every period
columns.caveat: what the row's ranking is and is not
